newsitem.title: INDIA: Tata AutoComp plans stake in JMB Tools.
newsitem.headline: Tata AutoComp plans stake in JMB Tools.

text.p: Tata AutoComp Systems Ltd (TACO) said on Thursday it is forming an alliance with JMB Tools Ltd (JMBT) under which it and its affiliates will take a 50 percent stake in the manufacturer of sheet metal components for automobiles.
The proposed alliance will involve TACO and Tata Industries Ltd (TIL) receiving a preferential allotment in Delhi based JMBT and taking equity shareholdings.
JMBT will ask shareholders to agree to make a preferential issue and allotment of 5.76 million shares, of 10 rupees each with a premium of 32 rupees per share, to TACO and TIL.
TACO and its affiliates in the Tata Group will invest 240 million rupees in JBMT and hold 50 percent of its equity.
And they will invest more to enable the joint venture to achieve annual sales of seven to eight billion rupees.
TACO has been set up as a holding company to promote a series of joint ventures in the auto-component business.
